From d7228a58d9438d6f219dc7f33eab0d1980b3bd2f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Benjamin Gray <bgray@linux.ibm.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2024 21:23:17 +1000
Subject: [PATCH] selftests/powerpc/dexcr: Add -no-pie to hashchk tests

The hashchk tests want to verify that the hash key is changed over exec.
It does so by calculating hashes at the same address across an exec.
This is made simpler by disabling PIE functionality, so we can
re-execute ourselves and be using the same addresses in the child.

While -fno-pie is already added, -no-pie is also required.

Fixes: bdb07f35a52f ("selftests/powerpc/dexcr: Add hashst/hashchk test")
Signed-off-by: Benjamin Gray <bgray@linux.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>
Link: https://msgid.link/20240417112325.728010-2-bgray@linux.ibm.com

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile b/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile
index 523947a38d17..1b775959f981 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ TEST_GEN_FILES := lsdexcr
 include ../../lib.mk
 include ../flags.mk
 
-$(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
+$(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie -no-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
 
 $(TEST_GEN_PROGS): ../harness.c ../utils.c ./dexcr.c
 $(TEST_GEN_FILES): ../utils.c ./dexcr.c
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile`**
   - The line that sets the `CFLAGS` for the `hashchk_test` target has been modified to include `-no-pie` in addition to the existing `-fno-pie`. The updated line is:
     ```make
     $(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie -no-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of `-no-pie` alongside `-fno-pie` is intended to enhance the functionality of the hashchk tests by ensuring that Position Independent Executable (PIE) functionality is disabled. This change allows the tests to verify that the hash key is consistently changed across executions at the same memory addresses, which is crucial for the integrity of the tests being performed. The modification directly addresses a limitation in the previous implementation, as indicated by the fix reference to a prior commit.

Link: https://msgid.link/20240417112325.728010-2-bgray@linux.ibm.com

Here is the root cause:
The hashchk tests were unable to reliably verify that the hash key changed over executions because the Position Independent Executable (PIE) functionality was enabled. This caused the tests to potentially run at different memory addresses across executions, making it difficult to compare hashes accurately. By disabling PIE with the addition of `-no-pie`, the tests can now consistently execute at the same addresses, allowing for proper validation of the hash key changes.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```makefile

```
Reason:
The `-fno-pie` flag disables Position Independent Executable (PIE) functionality, but it alone does not guarantee that the executable will run at the same address across executions. The absence of the `-no-pie` flag means that the tests could still be affected by PIE behavior, leading to inconsistent memory addresses and unreliable hash comparisons.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```makefile
$(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie -no-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
```
Reason:
By adding the `-no-pie` flag, the tests are explicitly instructed to disable PIE functionality, ensuring that the executable runs at the same memory addresses across executions. This consistency allows for accurate validation of the hash key changes during the tests.
